option_relations.rationale: The option 'Sepsis with encephalopathy' directly matches the leaf label 'sepsis with encephalopathy'.
The option 'Septic shock with anuric kidney failure' does not directly match any leaf labels and includes 'anuric kidney failure' which is not mentioned in the vignette.
The option 'Sepsis secondary to Pneumonia' directly matches the leaf label 'sepsis secondary to pneumonia'.
The option 'Pneumonia leading to sepsis and encephalopathy' directly matches the leaf labels 'pneumonia leading to sepsis and encephalopathy'.
